name: Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab for Advanced pMMR Endometrial Carcinoma (KEYNOTE-775)

biomarkers.note: This combination is the biomarker directed option for mismatch repair PROFICIENT (pMMR) advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma after prior platinum based therapy (KEYNOTE-775). dMMR/MSI-H disease is instead treated with single agent checkpoint blockade (see gyn-endometrial-io-dmmr). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, ENDO-D 2 of 6 and ENDO-D 3 of 6 (Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab, pMMR tumors, category 1).

lineOfTherapy: biomarker directed therapy for pMMR advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma after prior platinum based therapy (including neoadjuvant and adjuvant); second line and subsequent

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, ENDO-D 2 of 6 (Biomarker-directed therapy, pMMR tumors: Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab, category 1)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: prior platinum based therapy (including neoadjuvant and adjuvant)

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 233347 (pembrolizumab flat dose of 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 233347. Pembrolizumab flat 200 mg IV every 3 weeks (source stated alternative 400 mg every 6 weeks). Manage immune related adverse events per checkpoint inhibitor toxicity guidance.

drugs.name: Lenvatinib

provenance.locator: ENDO-D 2 of 6 and ENDO-D 3 of 6 (Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab, category 1) - regimen identity only; per drug flat mg not printed on this page

drugs.notes: VERIFY: the flat oral daily lenvatinib dose (KEYNOTE-775) is not printed in the licensed core (DeVita 12th ed.) or guideline (NCCN Uterine v3.2026) text available for grounding. NCCN ENDO-D names Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab as a category 1 pMMR option but does not print the mg. Dose must be verified against the drug label / study protocol before this protocol can leave DRAFT. Given once daily continuously (not cycle bound).

regimen.cycles: continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity (pembrolizumab up to the source stated 2 year ceiling); lenvatinib dosed continuously once daily
supportiveCare: immune related adverse event monitoring for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, endocrinopathies).
lenvatinib specific monitoring: blood pressure (antihypertensive management), proteinuria, thyroid function, and hepatic function.

monitoring: blood pressure monitoring for lenvatinib (frequent, especially first cycles)
immune related toxicity screen during pembrolizumab

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune related adverse event guidance; clinical review before rechallenge.

doseModificationRules.condition: uncontrolled hypertension, significant proteinuria, or other grade 3 or higher lenvatinib toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce lenvatinib per label; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 233347 (pembrolizumab flat 200 mg every 3 weeks); lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab in advanced endometrial cancer referenced at line 33967 (Makker et al.) without a printed mg

guideline.locator: Systemic Therapy for Endometrial Carcinoma, Biomarker-directed therapy, pMMR tumors: Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab (ENDO-D 2 of 6 and ENDO-D 3 of 6; category 1)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab (KEYNOTE-775) in mismatch repair proficient (pMMR) advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma (StewardMD reference disease endometrial cancer, subtype group #43). The pembrolizumab flat dose (200 mg IV every 3 weeks, source stated alternative 400 mg every 6 weeks) is grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 233347. The lenvatinib once daily oral flat mg is set to VERIFY: it is not printed in the licensed core (DeVita) or guideline (NCCN Uterine v3.2026 ENDO-D, which names the category 1 pMMR regimen without printing the mg) text available, and must not be invented. Biomarker gate (pMMR) and category 1 status are per NCCN Uterine v3.2026 ENDO-D 2 of 6 and 3 of 6. verifyFields records the unresolved lenvatinib dose, which blocks status ACTIVE. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
